title: Expect

fields.name: key_exists
fields.description: Check if a key with a given name exists in the record.

fields.name: key_not_exists
fields.description: Check if a key does not exist in the record.

fields.name: key_val_is_null
fields.description: check that the value of the key is NULL.

fields.name: key_val_is_not_null
fields.description: check that the value of the key is NOT NULL.

fields.name: key_val_eq
fields.description: check that the value of the key equals the given value in the configuration.

fields.name: action
fields.description: action to take when a rule does not match.

fields.name: result_key
fields.description: specify a key name of matching result.

fields.name: match
fields.description: Tag match pattern used to route records to this plugin. Supports '*' wildcard matching.

fields.name: match_regex
fields.description: Regular expression tag match used to route records to this plugin. Takes precedence over match when both are set.

description: The expect filter plugin allows you to validate that records match certain criteria in their structure, like validating that a key exists or it has a specific value.
